name: luna-max-coder
description: Route only code edits and browser actions to GPT-5.6 Luna / Max while the selected advanced primary handles every other operation.

interface.shortDescription: Advanced supervision with Luna code edits and browser actions only.
interface.longDescription: An accepted non-Luna primary plans, inspects files, runs shell and SSH, performs research and MCP work, executes tests, controls risk, and reviews. A fresh GPT-5.6 Luna / Max worker receives only one exact code patch or one bounded browser interaction under a cumulative lifetime budget. Mixed or operational tasks remain with the primary, and resumes cannot reset the budget.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $code-routing to keep planning, inspection, shell, tests, and review in the selected advanced primary while routing only code edits or browser actions to one bounded Luna Max worker.
